products.title: Vibora Black Mamba Radical 12k 2.0 2025 - by Vibor
products.description:
VIBORA BLACK MAMBA RADICAL 12K 2.0 2025 - Compañer@s, we present to you this model, one of the most spectacular from Vibora. Hybrid format racket, very complete, made of 12K carbon fiber. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The VIBORA BLACK MAMBA RADICAL 12K 2.0 2025 belongs to the Radical line, this being its second season. It is modernized for the 2025 season, giving this model one of the most beautiful designs we have seen in black and gray carbon tones, topped with a spectacular matte yellow.

PLAYER TYPE

Due to the level of this racket, we recommend it to expert to professional players. The professional players of the brand will be the one they wear this season.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

As for the technical characteristics, we see a lot of similarity with its predecessor, because if something goes well, it is better not to touch it too much. We see a hybrid format racket, between teardrop and rounded, which leaves us with great sensations in attack, but also in the defense zone.

Manufactured using 12K Carbon in the planes and frame. It is a super resistant material and one of the hardest to provide greater power in blows.

This racket uses Laminated Eva Rubber, a new rubber that offers greater rebound and less vibrations.

PLAY STYLE

On the track, it's genius, honestly. It is a shovel that works for everything. One of the best Vibora padel rackets that you can try today. You may notice it a little more for power than for control.

products.title: Wilson Blade V4 2026 - Wilson
products.description:
WILSON BLADE V4 2026 - The new Blade arrives renewed, with a slight design change and with improved technologies to achieve a more balanced and durable racket. Without a doubt, one of the Wilson rackets with the best quality-price ratio. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The WILSON BLADE V4 2026 arrives completely renewed to continue being one of the brand's most balanced padel rackets. Its teardrop format helps us achieve that balance so desired by players.

It is a racket that transmits a lot of confidence both from the back of the court and in the net game.

PLAYER TYPE

Designed for players looking for an excellent compromise between control, power and comfort, it offers a very versatile behavior that adapts to any match situation.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The materials in the WILSON BLADE V4 2026 are quality. We find a combination of carbon fiber and fiberglass. With this duo, a balanced, flexible feel and good durability are achieved.

Its rubber is firm Foam, a hard and stable rubber that increases the power in our blows, but also leaving us with the characteristic softness of foam rubber.

Its technologies are: a rough surface Spin Effect Texture, which facilitates the generation of effects. Its C2 Tubular Construction structure, made entirely of carbon. In addition, the Anti-Fragile Edge protector reinforces the frame against bumps and scratches, while the Duo Grid Hole system optimizes the performance of the hitting surface.

products.title: Enebe Mustang 12k Blue 2025 - Bullpadel
products.description:
ENEBE MUSTANG 12K BLUE 2025. One of Enebe's highest range padel rackets, with a very careful design and roughness on the faces.

 INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The ENEBE MUSTANG 12K BLUE 2025 offers us a gaming tool made entirely of carbon, with a refined black aesthetic with details in electric blue and silver. 

PLAYER TYPE

Due to its feel, rubber and balance, it will be highly valued among advanced players, as it will help them enormously in both defensive and attacking shots. 

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

This Enebe attracts attention both for its appearance and for its behavior on the track. The materials for its manufacture have been chosen with great care to produce a spectacular padel racket. The carbon used for the faces is top quality 12K, giving the sensation of robustness and intermediate cushioning. We find roughness for those looking to play with a lot of spin. The rubber included inside is Black EVA HR7 high rebound, which provides excellent response when hitting the ball. We find the padel racket with a medium-high balance, very useful for the aerial game and aggressive hits. The shape of the blade is teardrop, offering a good sweet spot slightly displaced upwards.

PLAY STYLE

This Mustang 12K BLUE comes on the market to satisfy players who have been playing for a long time and are looking for a racket that helps them define the points on the net and easily get the balls from behind.

products.title: Asics Gel Challenger 15 Padel L.e. Safety Yellow Twilight Blue 2026 - Asics
products.description:
ASICS GEL CHALLENGER 15 PADEL L.E. SAFETY YELLOW TWILIGHT BLUE 2026 - New limited edition padel shoes from the Challenger series. With fluorine yellow as the main color with which we will not go unnoticed.  The new ASICS GEL CHALLENGER 15 PADEL L.E. SAFETY YELLOW TWILIGHT BLUE 2026 are a limited edition of this season. An ideal model for advanced-professional level players since it is a shoe with a lot of character and with the most advanced Asics Padel technologies.

The Safety Yellow finish combined with Twilight Blue provides a powerful and dynamic aesthetic, ideal for those who want to stand out on the court both for their game and for their style.

The stability of the Challenger series is always the real protagonist. This model is aimed at players who move intensely from side to side. Its structure reinforces the support of the foot to keep it stable in quick changes of direction and demanding supports. Furthermore, a key factor for this is the incorporation of the WINGWALL system, which improves lateral stability.

For comfortable cushioning at all times, it incorporates GEL technology in the rear area. This absorbs impacts and reduces the load on the heel, offering a more comfortable footprint during long matches.

The sole has been designed to offer optimal traction on sandy synthetic grass surfaces, facilitating controlled movements and safe sliding.

products.title: Paletero Nox Ml10 Team Black Clay 2025 - Nox
products.description:
NOX ML10 TEAM BLACK CLAY 2025 PADEL BAG - New Nox 2025 season padel bag in black and clay orange. Are you looking for a padel racket bag with space and compartments for all your padel accessories? The NOX ML10 TEAM BLACK CLAY 2025 PADEL BAG is one of the best alternatives for Nox padel bags of the season. Created in collaboration with Miguel Lamperti, this model combines style and functionality.

It has a capacity of 55 liters and allows you to carry up to 4 shovels, clothes and accessories without worries.

Of all its compartments, we highlight the one for padel rackets with NOX ThermoTech technology, which protects your rackets or bottles from temperature changes.
